{{Quote|I am nothing more than a humble crate maker. If people wish to hide bacta injectors or armor power-ups in them, that is their doing... not mine.|Talan Joben, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />}}
'''Talan Joben''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] businessman who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Joben was the owner of the [[Joben Crate Company]], a crate manufacturing company based near [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]].<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> his company was attacked by the retired adventurer [[Riyan Kiner]]. The insane crate-hating man also planted bombs in Joben-brand crates that were placed near [[Hotel/Legends|hotels]] on several worlds in the galaxy. A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] investigating the attack of the Joben Crate Company for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' reporter [[Vani Korr]] finally discovered the plot. The spacer then managed to disable the bombs before they could hurt anybody.<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talan Joben appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TMHP1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Talan Joben was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
